definitions.explanation: A literary or poetic word for a kiss. More elegant and romantic than the loanword キス, and typically used in fiction, poetry, and formal or artistic contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}づけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わした→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧。
⟦{別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}→別れ際：07471_wakaregiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦そっと→そっと：03321_sotto⟧{口|くち}づけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She gently kissed him as they parted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シーン→シーン：08914_shiin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月明|つきあ}かり→月明かり：05047_tsukiakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下|もと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{口|くち}づけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わした→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧。
examples.english: In the final scene of the novel, the protagonists kissed under the moonlight.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and somewhat old-fashioned word. In everyday conversation, Japanese speakers use ⟦キス→キス：09763_kisu⟧ instead. {口|くち}づけ appears mainly in novels, poetry, song lyrics, and dramatic narration. It conveys a more romantic, tender, or solemn tone than ⟦キス→キス：09763_kisu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口|くち}づけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧ (to exchange a kiss)
- {口|くち}づけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to kiss)
- ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧{口|くち}づけ (a light kiss)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦キス→キス：09763_kisu⟧: kiss — the everyday loanword, used in casual speech
- ⟦{接吻|せっぷん}→接吻：18432_seppun⟧: kiss — even more formal and literary; somewhat archaic
